texts.preamble: Sheikh Babu vs State Of Odisha & Ors. .... Opposite ... on 24 April, 2025 Author: S.K. Panigrahi Bench: S.K. Panigrahi In The High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack W.P.(C) No.9832 of 2025 Sheikh Babu .... Pet Mr. Kaibalya Pan Mr. P. Pa -versus- State of Odisha & Ors. .... Opposite P Miss Gayatri Pat Coram: Hon'Ble Dr. Justice S.K. Panigrahi Order
texts.facts: 2. In filing this Writ Petition, the Petitioner being the owner of the meat (mutton) shop in question has challenged the action of the authority concerned in locking and sealing his meat shop on the allegation of adulteration of prohibited meat. Apart from the above, the Petitioner has also challenged the notice issued by the Food Safety Officer, Puri Municipality vide Annexure-1. 3. At this juncture, Ms. Rajeswari Pati, the Food and Safety Officer, Puri submits that pursuant to the allegation of selling of prohibited meat in the shop of the Petitioner, she after following all criteria had taken the samples from the meat (mutton) shop of the present Petitioner. After analysis of the said samples though it was found that there was no adulteration of prohibited meat, the quality of the meat was poor. Hence, the shop of the Petitioner has been sealed. 7. At this juncture, the Petitioner through his Advocate undertakes to sell good quality of meat (mutton) in future.
texts.arguments: 4. Pursuant to the earlier direction of this Court the Director- cum-Chief Food Analyst, Government of Odisha and the Designation: Personal Assistant Location: High Court of Orissa 5. Learned counsel for the Petitioner submits that the Date: 29-Apr-2025 18:48:05 Petitioner has been running the meat (mutton) shop in question since last fifty years. He has never sold any other prohibited meat in his shop. Learned counsel for the Petitioner further contends that due to spreading of rumor regarding selling of prohibited meat in the shop of the Petitioner by some miscreants in the Social Media, the shop of the Petitioner in question has been sealed. Due to sealing of the shop of the Petitioner, the Petitioner is suffering immensely. He, accordingly, prays for allowing the prayer of the Petitioner.
